metadata.title: Duplicate author value negative example
metadata.description: Representative invalid example: two author children inside the same authors element share the identical value. The PML schema itself does not reject this (no uniqueness constraint on sibling author text); rejection must come from a repository-owned content check, not xmllint/schema validation.

prompt.goal: Demonstrate that two identical author values inside one authors element are schema-valid but must be rejected by a repository-owned uniqueness check.
